summary: Resolve Electron special-path names through the native host path service.

requirements.name: statically known supported Electron path name preferred

target.notes: Return paths using Electron-compatible special-directory meanings, not a generic current-directory mapping.

caveats: Names such as appData, userData, temp, desktop and logs have Electron-defined meanings that differ by OS.
setPath overrides must be observed by subsequent getPath calls.

tests.name: read user data path
tests.expected_behavior: returns the effective Electron-compatible userData path

tests.name: unknown path name
tests.expected_behavior: must fail the same way as Electron rather than silently returning an arbitrary directory
